verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware/security platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question. It also has programmatic surfaces (the YubiEnterprise REST API, ykman, SDKs) that could plausibly be exposed this way. A runtime probe found no MCP endpoint (mcp.yubico.com does not resolve), and nothing in the pack documents an official MCP server. The CLI and SDKs are only building blocks and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
